sections.description: Kalima AI Multilingual makes a WordPress site multilingual without any external subscription. Every language version of a piece of content is a real WordPress object - a real post, a real term - linked to the others by a shared translation-group id. AI translation from Gemini, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Anthropic Claude or DeepL, with a built-in Mock provider to prove the pipeline before spending a cent.
sections.changelog:
= 1.2.2 =
* Fixed: the shipping-zone country lookup no longer assumes a WooCommerce getter that does not exist - a failed lookup now falls back quietly, so a WooCommerce API difference can never stop the page mid-render.

= 1.2.1 =
* Improved: the globe dropdown is now a Shein-style panel - a Currency heading over a bordered listbox that shows only the current currency until it is clicked open, a separator line, then the language as one centered link that opens the language list. The current value carries a check mark in the open lists; the values stay real links, so the switch works without JavaScript (the script only folds the lists open and shut).

= 1.2.0 =
* Improved: the globe icon now prints the theme''s real wireframe earth glyph (U+E94A, .xts-i-global) instead of the interim translate symbol that rendered nothing in the theme''s icon font.
* Improved: in globe place the strip is moved directly AFTER the first visible header cart, and a CSS order rule pins that visual order even if a late theme pass reshuffles the cart node.
* Fixed: the language strip no longer flashes above the header on first paint - a body-child-only hide rule ships in the head and stops matching the moment the strip reaches its header place.
* Added: automatic update checks from the plugin''s own GitHub repository (Plugin Update Checker library, bundled). New releases show up on the Plugins screen exactly like a plugin from the official directory.
